title: EBT Data Segment
applicability: Included for EBT/eWIC transactions; appears in Data Section 3.
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length and request/response separator behavior only. Not field-by-field exhaustive.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the EBT Data Segment has fixed value 103.
Segment Length is 3 digits normally, or 4 digits specifically for EBT with eWIC data transactions.
A Financial Transaction request includes Field Separators between EBT Data Segment fields, but a Financial Transaction response omits Field Separators between the same fields.
The EBT Data Segment has a maximum length of 3,334 alphanumeric characters.

testCases.positive: Length is 4 digits for eWIC data, 3 digits otherwise
negative: 3-digit length used with eWIC data present

testCases.positive: Request has Field Separators; response omits them between the same fields

testDataStatus: Segment Type is covered by existing eWIC packages; the request-vs-response separator difference and eWIC 4-digit length variant need dedicated artifacts.
remaining: Author full field-by-field EBT Data Segment coverage (Voucher ID, WIC Discount Amount, WIC Product Data, EBT Program Data) beyond this core-structure baseline.
